response_contract.format: Figshare original public version-1 article metadata JSON: original release file identity contains two alternate GIS archives (GDW_v1_0_gdb.zip and GDW_v1_0_shp.zip) AND a separately published final technical document (GDW_TechDoc_v1_0.pdf). These are 3 archival files, not 3 independent scientific datasets.
response_contract.scientific_semantics: Global Dam Watch v1.0 is a global river-barrier and reservoir reference database. The published release contains a barrier point layer and an associated reservoir polygon layer; these are distinct scientific objects linked by identifiers/location, and not every barrier has an associated reservoir polygon. The two release ZIPs are alternate Geodatabase and Shapefile delivery representations, not independent scientific releases. The published v1.0 inventory reports 41,145 barrier points and 35,295 associated reservoir polygons. Presence in the database does not establish dam-failure probability, structural fragility, reservoir operating state, current asset status, downstream inundation or catastrophe-model fitness.

operational_constraints.rate_limit_notes: Figshare official API documentation recommends at most one request per second and reserves throttle/block rights. This contract permits one explicitly invoked fixed metadata GET without pagination, redirects, retry, file retrieval or a scheduled acquisition loop.
operational_constraints.mutability_notes: Original version-specific Figshare v1 public article JSON retrieved 2026-11-04 and reported article total 127,938,795 bytes comprising final PDF (716,288 bytes, file 47913739), Geodatabase ZIP (57,476,758 bytes, 47913742) and Shapefile ZIP (69,745,749 bytes, 47913754). Provider-supplied and computed MD5 fields agreed for each file; these are metadata declarations, not independently recalculated byte receipts. Any version or metadata drift must fail closed. Original ZIP/GIS file acquisition requires distinct review, exact SHA-256, attribute/geometry quality gates and full final v1 TechDoc rights check.

rights_and_policy.notes: Global Dam Watch v1.0 original Figshare item and peer-reviewed article identify CC BY 4.0; Figshare's public Data Access Policy and official API guide authorize anonymous public metadata access and responsible API use. This permits one explicit version-pinned metadata canary only. It does not approve any GIS ZIP download, raw/derived data redistribution in this repository, scientific model use or unattended crawling. The final release Technical Documentation and exact selected file must be reviewed before acquiring or publishing original GIS bytes.
